name: ai.llpro/campus
title: LLPRO Campus
description: 100+ agent tools. Free daily quota; credit keys from $1 at llpro.ai/pay/credit; x402 accepted.

tools.name: ground_truth_ask
tools.description: Get a current public fact for any place, with its source link and time: weather, weather alerts, river levels, floods, earthquakes, disasters, air quality. Free daily quota. Example: {"topic": "weather", "place": "Austin, Texas"} Free daily quota; credit keys from $1 at llpro.ai/pay/credit; x402 accepted. Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <llk_ key>. We charge only while this tool passes today's known-answer test; in testing it answers free. Docs: https://llpro.ai/ground-truth

topic.description: One of: weather, weather_alerts, river_level, flood, earthquakes, disasters, air_quality, road_closures, power_outages, burn_ban (or give free text in q and the topic is guessed). Not connected yet: road_closures, power_outages; burn_ban is partial (US Red Flag only); weather_alerts is US only.

place.description: Any place name, e.g. 'Lafayette' or 'Lagos, Nigeria'; or use lat+lon

max_age_minutes.description: Mark answers older than this as stale

tools.name: page_to_text
tools.description: Read a public web page as clean text: title, visible text (up to 20,000 characters) and its links. Free, nothing stored. Example: {"url": "https://example.com/"}. Docs: https://llpro.ai/page-to-text

tools.name: agent_ready_check
tools.description: Check whether a website is ready for AI agents: looks for llms.txt, an agent card and an MCP server card, and says what is missing. Free. Example: {"domain": "example.com"}. Docs: https://llpro.ai/agent-ready-check

domain.description: Domain name to check, e.g. example.com (a full URL is accepted; only the host name is used).

tools.name: countersign_stamp
tools.description: Check a piece of work (report, calculation, summary, filing draft) by separate code and get a signed pass, fail or inconclusive stamp that says exactly what is wrong. Free daily limit. Example: {"output": "12 invoices at $40 each: 12 * 40 = 480", "producer": {"agent_id": "my-agent"}, "kind": "calculation"} Free daily quota; credit keys from $1 at llpro.ai/pay/credit; x402 accepted. Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <llk_ key>. We charge only while this tool passes today's known-answer test; in testing it answers free. Docs: https://llpro.ai/countersign

output.description: The work to check, as text (max 100000 chars). Equations written as '12 * 4 = 48' are re-computed.

producer.description: Who made the work: {agent_id, model}. Required; used for the independence rule.

claims.description: Optional explicit items: {type:'arithmetic', expression, claimed} or {type:'quote', source_url, quote} or {type:'value', source_url, value}

language.description: For code: python or json get a syntax check

private.description: If true the public log shows only a hash of each finding's detail; you still get the full detail

tools.name: domain_health_check
tools.description: Check a domain's mail and DNS health: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, certificate expiry and blocklists, each pass or fail with what to do. Free. Example: {"domain": "example.com"}. Docs: https://llpro.ai/domain-health-check

domain.description: A domain name such as example.com. Not a URL, address or email.

dkim_selectors.description: Optional DKIM selector names you use (the part before ._domainkey). We also try 12 common ones.

tools.name: agentrecord_lookup
tools.description: Look up the public record of an agent or MCP server: does it answer, how fast, and its signed delivery record. Free. Example: {"target": "https://llpro.ai/mcp"} Free daily quota; credit keys from $1 at llpro.ai/pay/credit; x402 accepted. Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <llk_ key>. We charge only while this tool passes today's known-answer test; in testing it answers free.

target.description: Endpoint URL, registry name (e.g. ai.llpro.countersign/countersign) or agent id

tools.name: invoice_make
tools.description: Make a PDF invoice from invoice fields and get a signed, dated receipt of the PDF. Free. Example: {"number": "INV-1001", "issue_date": "2026-11-23", "currency": "USD", "seller": {"name": "Acme LLC"}, "buyer": {"name": "Beta Inc"}, "items": [{"description": "Consulting", "quantity": 2, "unit_price": 150}]}. Docs: https://llpro.ai/invoice-maker

number.description: Invoice number: letters, digits, space and . _ / # - (1 to 40).

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the issue date.

currency.description: Three-letter code, for example USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

address.description: Up to 6 lines (list of strings, or one string with line breaks), 80 characters each.

contact.description: An email address or phone number. No web addresses.

quantity.description: More than 0 and at most 1,000,000, up to 4 decimal places (a number, or text such as "2.5").

unit_price.description: At most 1,000,000,000 in size, up to 4 decimal places; a line may not exceed 10,000,000,000 and the total 100,000,000,000; may be negative for a credit line (the invoice total may not be negative).

rate_percent.description: 0 to 100, up to 4 decimal places, applied to the subtotal. Your number, not ours.

amount.description: A fixed tax amount instead of a rate (0 or more).

payment_terms.description: Plain words, for example 'Net 30. Bank transfer, account details sent separately.' No web addresses.

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: Count US business days between two dates, or step a number of business days from a date (skips weekends and federal holidays). Free. Example: {"start": "2026-11-20", "end": "2026-12-01"}

end.description: To count: the end date, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after start. Send end or add_business_days, not both.

add_business_days.description: To step: how many business days after start (negative: before start), not counting start itself. 1 = the next business day. Not 0.

holidays.description: federal_offices (default): 5 U.S.C. 6103 holidays, Saturday ones on the Friday before and Sunday ones on the Monday after. federal_reserve_banks: the same holidays, Sunday ones on Monday, Saturday ones not moved.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'notice period' (your own text, echoed).

tools.name: list_clean
tools.description:
Clean a contact list (CSV text): trims, fixes case, normalizes phones and emails, and removes duplicates by a key column. Free, nothing stored. Example: {"text": "name,email
Ann ,ANN@Example.com
ann,ann@example.com
", "key_column": "email"}

text.description: The CSV or list as text. The first row is read as the header unless header is false.

header.description: First row is a header (default true).

key_column.description: Column name or 1-based number to remove duplicates on. Leave out to compare the whole row.

dedupe.description: Remove duplicate rows (default true). The first copy is kept; comparison ignores upper/lower case.

tools.name: sitemap_read
tools.description: Read a website's sitemap: the page addresses it lists, with last-changed dates. Free. Example: {"site": "llpro.ai"}. Docs: https://llpro.ai/sitemap-reader

site.description: A domain such as example.com, or the public http(s) address of a sitemap.

tools.name: qr_code_make
tools.description: Make a QR code for a link, as an image. Free. Example: {"url": "https://llpro.ai/", "format": "both"}. Docs: https://llpro.ai/qr-codes

url.description: A public http(s) link to encode, ASCII only (percent-encode anything else). Port 80 or 443 only.

text.description: Plain text to encode. Active schemes (javascript:, data:, file:, tel:, sms:, mailto:, WIFI: and similar) are refused.

stamp_id.description: A Countersign stamp id such as cs_28d71a5f8f427055. The code opens its verify page.

ec_level.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15%, Q 25%, H 30% of the code can be damaged and still scan.

scale.description: PNG pixels per module (a code is 25 to 65 modules wide with its quiet border).

tools.name: launchpad_start
tools.description: Turn a goal into a step-by-step plan: which tools to use, the first task to run, and what needs your owner's approval. Free; the goal is never stored. Example: {"goal": "Check whether our supplier invoices this month have duplicates"}

goal.description: What you are trying to get done, in a sentence or two.

constraints.description: Optional limits. They only ever make the plan stricter.

agent_id.description: A stable name for you. Used only to count return visits.

tools.name: ask_campus
tools.description: Ask a plain question about LLPRO itself: its tools, prices, privacy, refunds, how to connect. Answers quote LLPRO's own pages. Example: {"question": "Is Ground Truth free?"}

question.description: Your question in plain words, under 400 characters.

agent_id.description: Optional: your agent id; the daily limit counts per agent id.

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Search all LLPRO tools (about 250: facts, web pages, documents, finance, compliance, trust and records) by what you want done, in plain words. Returns up to 10 matching tools: name, what it does, its input fields and an example call. Free, no sign-up, nothing stored. Example: {"query": "check a vendor invoice for duplicates"}

query.description: The job in a few plain words, e.g. 'late fee on an invoice' or 'is this VAT number valid'.

tools.name: use_tool
tools.description: Run any LLPRO tool by its name, including the ones not in this short list. Send the tool name and its arguments; the answer is exactly what that tool returns. Same free daily limit as calling it directly. Example: {"name": "<tool name>", "arguments": {"domain": "example.com"}}. Docs: https://llpro.ai/connect

name.description: The exact tool name (letters, digits and underscores).

arguments.description: The tool's arguments as an object ({} if none).
